significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish a form-(iii) threshold law—internal separation and forecast direction track whether R_t is above or below exactly 1 even for a “matched recent curve, opposite R_t side”—supplemented by the form-(ii) claim that steering the recovered direction causally flips growth versus decline. This establishes both a behavioral phenomenon at ambiguous turning points and a mechanism, constraining what representations and forecasts should do across threshold crossings rather than merely showing that R_t is decodable; the exact threshold relation is materially sharper than the topic-median probe-plus-steering hypothesis, and Cori et al.'s EpiEstim framework makes the R_t=1 boundary an operational epidemiological quantity rather than a loose semantic label. The branches are determinate: a positive result supports threshold-sensitive computation, while a null beyond momentum plus failure on opposite-R_t pairs rules out that explanation for the covered TSFMs, although it would not rule out all other mechanistic epidemic representations. In the topic-substitution check, the generic topic alone would not earn this score: the added threshold locality, momentum-controlled coupling, and opposite forecasts are specific constraints false of the median scientific-concept probing claim.

reach.justification: The claim names several reusable handles: the “Threshold-Beyond-Momentum Index,” the “Matched-Curve Separation Ratio,” and a causal “R-threshold direction,” together with the deployment rule to “require explicit mechanistic (R_t-aware) validation before any TSFM is used for epidemic policy counterfactuals.” These can operate ex ante by screening a forecasting model before it is trusted for turning-point or policy decisions, leaving an action window for benchmark authors, TSFM developers, and public-health model auditors rather than merely explaining an observed error afterward. After per-model re-extraction, the substantive prediction survives as a relation—the internal transition and forecast reversal should localize near R_t=1 beyond matched momentum—across the asserted class of epidemic TSFMs, although its reach does not extend to unrelated scientific domains or automatically to public-health policymakers themselves. The topic-substitution check does not preserve the score: generic investigation of scientific representations supplies no comparable pre-deployment audit, transferable threshold relation, or intervention handle.
